_doc: Raw Materials & Mining — lithium, nickel, cobalt, graphite producers. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

albemarle.one_liner: World's largest lithium producer; brine + hard-rock, plus bromine.

sqm.one_liner: Chilean lithium & specialty-chemicals major mining the Atacama salar.

ganfeng lithium.one_liner: Vertically integrated Chinese lithium giant, mine-to-battery.

arcadium lithium.one_liner: Formed by the Livent + Allkem merger; acquired by Rio Tinto (2025).

glencore.one_liner: Diversified miner & trader; major cobalt/nickel plus Li-ion recycling.

vale.one_liner: Brazilian mining major and one of the world's largest nickel producers.

bhp.one_liner: Global resources major; nickel for battery cathodes (Nickel West).

syrah resources.one_liner: Graphite miner (Balama, Mozambique) + US anode plant (Vidalia).

tianqi lithium.one_liner: Chinese lithium major; large equity stakes in Greenbushes (Australia) and SQM.

mineral resources.one_liner: Australian mining-services company; lithium (Mt Marion, Wodgina) alongside iron ore.

norilsk nickel.one_liner: Russian mining major; one of the world's largest refined nickel and palladium producers.

china molybdenum.one_liner: Chinese diversified miner; major cobalt and copper producer via DRC operations (incl. Tenke Fungurume, Kisanfu).

igo.one_liner: Australian miner; stake in the Greenbushes lithium mine plus nickel operations.

eurasian resources group.one_liner: Luxembourg-headquartered diversified miner with major cobalt operations in the DRC.

sherritt international.one_liner: Canadian miner; cobalt and nickel refining, notably the Moa Joint Venture in Cuba.

anglo american.one_liner: British-South African diversified miner; nickel operations feed battery cathode supply.

talon metals.one_liner: Canadian explorer/developer of the Tamarack nickel project in Minnesota, USA.

magnis energy.one_liner: Australian graphite developer (Nachu project, Tanzania) with battery-manufacturing ambitions.

nouveau monde graphite.one_liner: Canadian graphite developer (Matawinie project, Quebec) targeting battery anode material.

sigma lithium.one_liner: Spodumene concentrate producer at Grota do Cirilo, Brazil.

eramet.one_liner: French mining group; manganese and nickel (New Caledonia, Indonesia) plus a lithium project in Argentina.
